name: changelog-keeper
description: Keeps CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased section up to date as you commit.

path.title: Changelog file
path.description: Path of the changelog, relative to the repository root.

createIfMissing.title: Create the file if missing
createIfMissing.description: Start a Keep a Changelog file on the first entry when the repository has none.

untyped.title: Commits without a type
untyped.description: What a subject that is not a Conventional Commit becomes: an entry under Changed, or nothing.

includeChores.title: Include chores
includeChores.description: Also log docs, test, chore, ci, build and style commits (under Changed).

includeHash.title: Append the commit hash
includeHash.description: End each entry with the short commit hash, e.g. (a1b2c3d).
